# ROE Web payroll extract schema

Downloaded on 4 November 2026.

`PayrollExtractXmlV2.xsd` is Service Canada's schema for the ROE payroll extract, version 2.0. CanDo did not write it.

- File: https://srv136.services.gc.ca/ROE-RE/ROEWeb-REWeb/pub/resource/XmlV2Schema
- Page that links it (Appendix D): https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/programs/ei/ei-list/ei-roe/user-requirements/appendix-d.html
